info.title: Chloe Nguyen Tax Advisory platform API
info.description: Static summary of the agent tool endpoints. The complete spec (CRUD per table, JSON-Schema per tool) is generated live in the Workspace at #/studio/api-spec.

post.summary: Create a return, calculate it with the pinned rule pack and run the IRS business rules
post.description: Body {input, returnNumber?}. The vault stores the whole filing encrypted; the reply is a masked view. Roles: preparer, admin. Needs a signed-in session (Bearer token) when AUTH is on. Replies are no-store and never contain a full SSN, account number or PIN.

schema.description: Canonical return input (TY2026 model) and optional RET number

get.description: Query case, status. Roles: preparer, reviewer, admin. Needs a signed-in session (Bearer token) when AUTH is on. Replies are no-store and never contain a full SSN, account number or PIN.

get.summary: Masked view: status, amounts, findings, signature, submissions, staged package
get.description: Roles: preparer, reviewer, admin. Needs a signed-in session (Bearer token) when AUTH is on. Replies are no-store and never contain a full SSN, account number or PIN.

get.summary: Masked input (SSN last 4, account hidden, PIN "set")
get.description: Roles: preparer, reviewer, admin. Needs a signed-in session (Bearer token) when AUTH is on. Replies are no-store and never contain a full SSN, account number or PIN.

put.summary: Replace the input; clears approval, recalculates
put.description: Body {input, version?}. 409 STALE_VERSION when the version moved. Roles: preparer, admin. Needs a signed-in session (Bearer token) when AUTH is on. Replies are no-store and never contain a full SSN, account number or PIN.

post.description: {repin:true} (preparer, admin) accepts a newer rule pack after 409 RULE_PACK_CHANGED. Roles: preparer, reviewer, admin. Needs a signed-in session (Bearer token) when AUTH is on. Replies are no-store and never contain a full SSN, account number or PIN.

get.description: Roles: preparer, reviewer, admin. Needs a signed-in session (Bearer token) when AUTH is on. Replies are no-store and never contain a full SSN, account number or PIN.

post.summary: The signed-in preparer claims the return (PTIN)
post.description: Roles: preparer, admin. Needs a signed-in session (Bearer token) when AUTH is on. Replies are no-store and never contain a full SSN, account number or PIN.

post.summary: Reviewer approval (not the person who prepared or last edited it)
post.description: Roles: reviewer, admin. Needs a signed-in session (Bearer token) when AUTH is on. Replies are no-store and never contain a full SSN, account number or PIN.

get.summary: Amounts and hash the client signs on Form 8879
get.description: Roles: preparer, reviewer, admin. Needs a signed-in session (Bearer token) when AUTH is on. Replies are no-store and never contain a full SSN, account number or PIN.

post.summary: Record the client Form 8879 signature(s) for the amounts as they stand
post.description: Body {signers:[{who, pin, method, identityVerified, identityEvidence?}], efwConsent?}. The PIN is never returned. Roles: preparer, admin. Needs a signed-in session (Bearer token) when AUTH is on. Replies are no-store and never contain a full SSN, account number or PIN.

post.summary: Prepare for sending through the company transmitter
post.description: manual-keying: the keying sheet (masked). mef-direct: stage the MeF zip. partner-api: 501. Roles: preparer, admin. Needs a signed-in session (Bearer token) when AUTH is on. Replies are no-store and never contain a full SSN, account number or PIN.

get.summary: FreeTaxUSA keying sheet in screen order, each value linked to its source line
get.description: Query reveal=1&reason=... shows identifiers in clear; the reason is required and logged first. Roles: preparer, admin. Needs a signed-in session (Bearer token) when AUTH is on. Replies are no-store and never contain a full SSN, account number or PIN.

post.summary: The explicit human action: send (mef-direct) or mark submitted (manual-keying)
post.description: Body {confirm: <package or sheet id>, reference?}. Needs reviewer approval, a signed 8879, a Paid invoice and approver != sender. Never called by a job. Roles: preparer, admin. Needs a signed-in session (Bearer token) when AUTH is on. Replies are no-store and never contain a full SSN, account number or PIN.

post.summary: Record the IRS acknowledgment for a manually keyed return
post.description: Body {status, errors[], receivedAt?, override?}. A second ack is 409 ACK_EXISTS; override is admin only. Roles: preparer, admin. Needs a signed-in session (Bearer token) when AUTH is on. Replies are no-store and never contain a full SSN, account number or PIN.

post.summary: Record that the client was told about a reject (stops the 24 h clock)
post.description: Roles: preparer, admin. Needs a signed-in session (Bearer token) when AUTH is on. Replies are no-store and never contain a full SSN, account number or PIN.

get.summary: Download a staged or sent IFA package (zip, logged before the bytes leave)
get.description: Roles: preparer, admin. Needs a signed-in session (Bearer token) when AUTH is on. Replies are no-store and never contain a full SSN, account number or PIN.

post.summary: Record the IRS acknowledgment read in e-Services (MeF submissions)
post.description: Body {submissionId, status, errors[], receivedAt?, override?}. Roles: preparer, admin. Needs a signed-in session (Bearer token) when AUTH is on. Replies are no-store and never contain a full SSN, account number or PIN.

get.summary: Rejects whose client notice is due or overdue
get.description: Roles: preparer, reviewer, admin. Needs a signed-in session (Bearer token) when AUTH is on. Replies are no-store and never contain a full SSN, account number or PIN.

post.description: Body {input | returnId, amountPaying?, efw?, confirm:true}. Needs a reviewer's approval of this exact request (POST /efile/extensions/approve) by someone other than the filer. Roles: preparer, admin. Needs a signed-in session (Bearer token) when AUTH is on. Replies are no-store and never contain a full SSN, account number or PIN.

get.description: Roles: preparer, reviewer, admin. Needs a signed-in session (Bearer token) when AUTH is on. Replies are no-store and never contain a full SSN, account number or PIN.

post.summary: Token route for tools/efile-offline: post an offline XSD result or an ack
post.description: Body {kind:"xsd", file:"<SID>.zip", valid, skipped, errors[], package_problems[], schema_version, company_id} or {kind:"ack", ...}. A skipped check is recorded but is not a pass. Roles: preparer, admin (session token; AUTH must be on). Needs a signed-in session (Bearer token) when AUTH is on. Replies are no-store and never contain a full SSN, account number or PIN.

get.description: Roles: admin. Needs a signed-in session (Bearer token) when AUTH is on. Replies are no-store and never contain a full SSN, account number or PIN.

post.summary: enable | disable | run the ack-and-deadline job
post.description: Roles: admin. Needs a signed-in session (Bearer token) when AUTH is on. Replies are no-store and never contain a full SSN, account number or PIN.

get.summary: Per-company e-file settings (EFIN, ETIN, Software IDs, transmitter, ...)
get.description: Roles: preparer, reviewer, admin. Needs a signed-in session (Bearer token) when AUTH is on. Replies are no-store and never contain a full SSN, account number or PIN.

post.description: transmitter is manual-keying (default), partner-api or mef-direct. Roles: admin. Needs a signed-in session (Bearer token) when AUTH is on. Replies are no-store and never contain a full SSN, account number or PIN.

get.description: Roles: preparer, reviewer, admin. Needs a signed-in session (Bearer token) when AUTH is on. Replies are no-store and never contain a full SSN, account number or PIN.

post.summary: Create or update a vault document
post.description: Roles: preparer, admin. Needs a signed-in session (Bearer token) when AUTH is on. Replies are no-store and never contain a full SSN, account number or PIN.

post.summary: Reveal full values with a reason (logged)
post.description: Roles: preparer, reviewer, admin. Needs a signed-in session (Bearer token) when AUTH is on. Replies are no-store and never contain a full SSN, account number or PIN.

get.description: Roles: reviewer, admin. Needs a signed-in session (Bearer token) when AUTH is on. Replies are no-store and never contain a full SSN, account number or PIN.
Roles: admin. Needs a signed-in session (Bearer token) when AUTH is on. Replies are no-store and never contain a full SSN, account number or PIN.

get.summary: Every calculated line with its source
get.description: Each line is either the sum of entered documents (document, box, input path, amount) or computed, with the engine's trace sentence. Roles: preparer, reviewer, admin. Needs a signed-in session (Bearer token) when AUTH is on. Replies are no-store and never contain a full SSN, account number or PIN.

post.description: Body {input | returnId, amountPaying?}. A reviewer or admin approves; the approval is single use and covers exactly this request. The person who approved cannot file it (403 SEPARATION_OF_DUTIES). Filing without it answers 409 APPROVAL_REQUIRED. Roles: reviewer, admin. Needs a signed-in session (Bearer token) when AUTH is on. Replies are no-store and never contain a full SSN, account number or PIN.

x-efile-note: Paths under /efile are served by the Cloudflare Worker (tools/worker), not by the static site; they need a signed-in staff session.
